notes.title: PATCH NOTE V 1.11
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26885387/7d6e846f815478cdc58614eb7941ae58b5eac706.jpg[/img]

Greetings contenders, We bring you good news with a patch Which main objective is to fix the long queue times. Finally We totally recommend the 2vs2 mode.

[h1] PATCH NOTE V 1.11[/h1]
[list]
 
 [*]Introducing a system that helps to reduce the queue time on the matchmaking.
 [*]Improved AI behaviour to make it more balanced and realistic.
 [*]Solved multiple bugs that had Ryunosuke. -> solves multiple bugs with Ryunosuke
 [*]Solved error with Darcey lifesteal on online games.
 [*]Introduces some changes making the Match Observer more stable and useful.
 [*]Minor graphical corrections.
[/list]

notes.title: Way of Redemption cross-play feature
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26885387/079fb8e66c9c8df0abd35a7863b8e3f79982ea7f.jpg[/img]

 [h1]  Hello again contenders! [/h1]  

As we have already mentioned before, crossplay is one a key feature of our new title, so we would like to discuss it in detail. Although crossplay is a fairly complex system at a technical level, from the beginning, we wanted to implement it because we believe it can be a substantial improvement in the users’ experience.

What does crossplay mean? Very simple, basically all players can compete with people from other platforms (PC and PS4). Thus, when looking for matches you will face users from both PS4 and PC platforms.

Another important point is that in addition to the crossplay, there is also the crossparty feature, which means that you can make groups to compete with a friend in 2 vs 2 matches or 3  more friends in friendly matches (1vs1 and 2vs2). These groups can also be formed by people from different platforms.

Currently there is no possibility to make groups by mixing several players on the same PC/PS4 if you want to play online. Groups can only be made with online players, each from their PC/PS4. Therefore, if several players are on the same machine they can only play local matches (offline). However, there is a chance to add this new feature later if the game gets enough community.

How do regions and servers work? The game is divided into several regions: Europe, South America, Western North America , Eastern North America and Asia. Players connected to a specific server can not play with players from other servers. Despite this, all statistics and player information go to a common server, so you really compete in ranked matches against all the players around the world.

This also means that players who move and prefer to play on another server, as long as they connect to the same account, have their progress and player stats updated at any time.

Finally, we do not forget the chat system, which you can configure to communicate both in the game on a global basis and with your teammate to carry out more effective strategies.

This is all for the moment as far as crossplay is concerned. Remember that if you have any doubts you can use the forum, the FAQ section and our mailbox.

https://youtu.be/CTYCN6rWuEw
